title: AI dogfood functional report
description: Structured output contract for the GPT 5.6-luna dogfood agent. Follows OpenAI structured-output strict-mode rules — every property is listed in required and optional fields are nullable — so it can be used as Codex's output-schema-file. Kept in sync by hand with assertDogfoodReport in .github/scripts/ai-dogfood/post-report.ts.

verdict.description: go = journeys that matter for this PR passed; conditional = useful but with skippable issues; no-go = a user-facing command the diff touches failed.

summary.description: Honest executive summary of what was exercised and what happened.

head_sha.description: PR HEAD SHA this run exercised. Copy from /tmp/ai-dogfood/head_sha.txt; do not invent one.

id.description: Short kebab-case journey id, e.g. create-link-push.

commands.description: CLI verbs actually invoked (without flags that could contain secrets).

result.description: pass = completed as expected; fail = unexpected error; skip = not applicable to this diff.

notes.description: What happened. No tokens, no passwords, no project JWT/db URLs with credentials.

blockers.description: User-visible failures. Empty array if none.

projects_deleted.description: Staging project refs this agent deleted. Empty if none or cleanup ran in CI after the agent.
